name: Deore / Deore DX pedal pair
weight_description: Weight not yet resolved: the 1989 catalogue lists 495 g per PD-MT60 pair, while the 1990 dealer manual lists 412 g per pair. The reviewed publications do not establish matching weighed configurations or a sufficiently identified variant to reconcile them. Neither figure is selected or averaged.
